the pins, whole
say: Next to the script, artie generate keeps the pins: a fingerprint of every form the walk used, nine of them across five systems. Before every act on a replay, ARTIE holds the form on offer now to its pin. Same form, same act. A form that's gone, or whose fields changed, and it stops before it sends anything. The one change it lets through by default is the target alone: a form that moved to a new address but asks for the same thing. That check is the whole reason a replay can be trusted with no model in it.
